excerpt: The Warp API lets you build custom apps and integrations that use your company's HR, payroll, time off, workplace, and department data.
REST: a standard HTTPS + JSON API you can use from any language or HTTP client.
Use the TypeScript SDK (warp-hr) or Go SDK (github.com/TeamWarp/warp-go-sdk) for authentication, pagination, retries, error handling, and webhook verification.
Use it to generate clients, configure API development tools, or give documentation-aware AI tools access to the Warp API definition.
The Warp API uses API keys to authenticate requests. Include your API key in the `x-api-key` header on every request.
If `hasMore` is `true`, pass the last object's ID as `afterId`
Call the API from Node.js, the browser, or any `fetch`-capable runtime with idiomatic, fully typed code.
Webhooks let your application react when data changes in Warp. Warp sends an HTTPS `POST` request to your endpoint for each event you subscribe to.
Warp implements the Standard Webhooks specification. You can verify deliveries with a standard verification library instead of maintaining custom cryptography.
It makes up to 12 delivery attempts with exponential backoff starting at 30 seconds.
When you exceed the rate limit, Warp returns an `HTTP 429` response with a `retryAt` timestamp indicating when you can retry your request.
